linux.label: linux

operations.name: isolation
operations.intent: the router runs with a sandbox home, state and PATH; nothing points at the real machine

checks.name: home, state, ledger and temp are inside the sandbox
no credential-shaped variable is passed
no Paseo, Herdr, Orca or T3 session variable is passed
the public AgentCompass entry runs from the checkout

operations.name: unit tests
operations.intent: the plugin boundary, the real worker.cjs bridge, the build script and the hotfix refusals, run inside this sandbox

checks.name: node --test: 30 passed, 0 failed
python unittest: 8 ran

operations.name: classifier configuration
operations.intent: agentcompass scorer --action set points the real classifier at the local fixture model

checks.name: scorer set exits 0
scorer show names the OpenAI-compatible type and masks the key

operations.name: build the plugin
operations.intent: scripts/build_plugin.py writes reviewable source bound to this AgentCompass and installs nothing

checks.name: build reports built
ghost.json, main.js, worker.cjs and router.json exist
router.json binds the public roll entry of this checkout with an absolute interpreter
the explicit account map is carried verbatim
the manifest asks for session context, node and tasks and exposes roll/status/stop/cleanup
building into an existing directory is refused
an incomplete account map is refused and nothing is written

operations.name: market contract gate
operations.intent: plugin/ as the market packs it, and the built source, pass the official repository gate (pinned validateGhostManifest, locales, icon, package rules)

checks.name: plugin/ passes the gate (7 checks)
the built source passes the gate (6 checks)
id agentcompass, name AgentCompass, a 256 px PNG icon and exactly en/ja/ko/zh-CN locales

operations.name: AgentCompass core: stock Cindy shell
operations.intent: raw shell roll in Cindy has no addressable parent: the core refuses instead of routing a provider thread to Paseo

checks.name: roll is refused (not launched) and names Cindy

operations.name: one task from roll to cleanup
operations.intent: trusted session context -> prepare through the real router -> create -> send -> status -> paged result -> cleanup

checks.name: both concurrent rolls succeed with one operation
the real classifier was asked once for the task
exactly one task was created and one input sent
the receipt belongs to the host-injected session, not the forged one
the real router routed for the Cindy session as a native parent
the plugin made the launcher permission explicit for the routed harness
codex: the router chose codex/gpt-6.1-sol, full-access, without fast mode
the create request carries the router's exact model/effort and the bypass permission
the text sent to Cindy contains the whole task byte for byte
the text sent to Cindy carries the return contract for a task without a mailbox
the router prompt names the real Cindy session as the parent
the sent text is the receipt's prompt (nothing cut)
the routing decision was recorded in the ledger for this session
status while running says there is no automatic callback and names the next call
cleanup of a running task is refused
status after completion returns the exact final message with all pages saved
every saved page exists on disk
cleanup archives once and repeating it is harmless
rolling the same assignment again does not create or send anything new
no duplicate create or send reached the host

operations.name: the real receipt in the plugin unit fixture
operations.intent: test/test_cindy_plugin.mjs replays the receipt the real router produced through main.js

checks.name: the plugin unit tests pass with the real receipt

operations.name: create answer lost
operations.intent: the host creates the draft but its answer never arrives: unknown_create, nothing is created or sent again, the orphan is not hidden

checks.name: roll reports unknown_create with the host's reason and the next call
status keeps saying unknown_create and tells the caller to inspect, not resend
rolling the same assignment again creates nothing new
no input was ever sent and no run exists
the orphan draft exists in the host and the plugin refuses to archive what it never saw

operations.name: a very large final reply
operations.intent: about 2.6 MB of final output crosses the real JSON-RPC bridge: a bounded summary, the complete text on disk

checks.name: the bridge survives the large page and status completes
the reply is bounded: summary at most 4000 characters, marked shortened, whole reply small
the complete final message is saved byte for byte in the artifact
cleanup still archives once

operations.name: host without the needed task API
operations.intent: missing or partial capabilities stop before the router is even asked; no task is created

checks.name: every roll is refused
the unsupported shapes say that no worker started
the router was never asked and nothing was created

operations.name: context that is not trusted
operations.intent: no host context, a remote workdir or a read-only one are refused before routing

checks.name: no context, a remote workdir and a read-only one are refused
nothing reached the router, the tasks API or a model

operations.name: wrong catalog, oversize task
operations.intent: the exact route must exist in the catalog; a task that does not fit the send limit is never cut

checks.name: a nearby model or an empty catalog is refused, never substituted
the oversize task is refused with the limit named
no task was created and no model input was sent

operations.name: draft in the wrong project directory
operations.intent: the created draft is checked before any input is sent; it is archived, or cleanup is handed back

checks.name: the first draft is blocked and archived, with no input sent
when archiving fails the reply says cleanup is needed and names the cleanup call
the stuck draft is archived by the cleanup tool

operations.name: the draft changed under us
operations.intent: a stale expectedRevision is rejected by the host: no run exists, nothing is resent

checks.name: the send conflict is reported as unknown_send with the host's reason
no run exists and the input was offered exactly once
collecting status never resends

operations.name: long transcript, stop and ownership
operations.intent: twelve pages are collected across two status calls; stop cancels through the scoped API; another session cannot touch the operation

checks.name: stop answers stopping, which is not a claim that the run ended
cleanup of a stopping run is refused
another session cannot read the operation
the first status stops at the page bound and says collection is incomplete
the second status finishes all twelve pages and finds the exact final message

operations.name: stop to a confirmed cancelled state, cleanup with and without archive
operations.intent: stop says stopping; only a host-confirmed cancelled run is terminal; cleanup archives, or hands back the exact task ID

checks.name: stop reports stopping and status keeps it non-terminal
after the host confirms, status reports cancelled as terminal with no invented output
cleanup archives the cancelled task
without an archive API cleanup returns manual_cleanup_required with the exact task ID, repeatably

operations.name: zero-config market install
operations.intent: plugin/ copied as is (no router.json, no build): the worker finds `agentcompass` on PATH, reads ~/.agent-compass/cindy-plugin/account-map.json, then roll -> status -> cleanup

checks.name: the installed copy has no router.json
an installed-style `agentcompass` launcher is on PATH (agentcompass)
roll starts a run through the discovered command
the real router answered natively for the Cindy session
the account map from the home directory was applied to the exact catalog route
status collects the exact final message and cleanup archives
the receipt is under ~/.agent-compass/cindy-plugin and the installed copy is unchanged

operations.name: every Cindy harness through the real router
operations.intent: Claude max and high, and Pi, reach exact catalog routes with Cindy bypassPermissions; codex is the first operation

checks.name: claude-max: the router chose claude/claude-opus-5-5 at max and the plugin made bypassPermissions explicit
claude-max: Cindy creates cc/claude/claude-opus-5-5/max with bypassPermissions and the run completes
claude-high: the router chose claude/claude-opus-5-5 at high and the plugin made bypassPermissions explicit
claude-high: Cindy creates cc/claude/claude-opus-5-5/high with bypassPermissions and the run completes
pi: the router chose the Pi harness on the codex account with its launch model; the fixed full-tool worker is full-access
pi: Cindy creates the exact pi route on the mapped connection with bypassPermissions and the run completes

operations.name: answers that are not a Cindy task, and fast mode
operations.intent: split (real router) and self come back unchanged and start nothing; a fast codex route maps to Cindy fastMode

checks.name: split from the real router is returned as is (task_count 2) and nothing is created
a plugin bound to the fixture router builds
self (fixture router) is returned as is and starts nothing
only the fast route created a task: one create, one send
fast (fixture router): codex/gpt-6.1-sol fast becomes Cindy fastMode true with bypassPermissions

linux.fast_mode_note: The real router chose no fast route in this sandbox: fast mode needs live, non-stale capacity telemetry for the codex window or an explicit --fast, which the plugin does not pass. The fast mapping is verified through test/fixture_router.cjs.
